readiness.reason: P1 findings affect market-data integrity, strategy validation, risk authority, execution/reconciliation, and security; no OMS or valid backtest exists.

categories.main_deductions: Uncalibrated scores and invalid outcome tracker.

categories.evidence: RR, open-count and advisory sizing exist.
categories.main_deductions: Fragmented fail-open gates; no daily loss, equity drawdown, or atomic reservation.

categories.name: Market-data integrity

categories.main_deductions: Open candles, duplicated ticker, false timeframe fallback, no source freshness/gap validation.

categories.name: Execution and order lifecycle
categories.evidence: Only signed balance GET and local SQLite trades exist.
categories.main_deductions: No executor, OMS, fills, idempotency, reconciliation, or exchange stop.

categories.main_deductions: No reconciliation/readiness/restore proof; dashboard unmanaged and paths inconsistent.

categories.main_deductions: No source-age, execution, exposure, mismatch, or active-version metrics.

findings.title: Open candle and current ticker are both included in indicators
findings.observed_behavior: All returned kline closes are accepted without close-time validation and the current ticker is appended to the selected price series.
findings.failure_scenario: An intrabar spike affects features twice, emits a signal, then reverses before candle close.
findings.impact: Unstable or false entry/exit signals and trend alignment.
findings.root_cause: No closed-candle cutoff and mixed ticker/candle semantics.
findings.recommendation: Use timestamped closed candles only and attach a data-cutoff timestamp to every signal.
findings.validation_test: Replay candle boundaries and prove features remain unchanged until the candle closes.

findings.title: 4h and 1d fallback can use the same non-independent series
findings.observed_behavior: The common prices series substitutes for either missing timeframe and can feed both timeframe calculations.
findings.failure_scenario: A daily/CoinGecko proxy appears aligned with itself and is classified strong or partial.
findings.impact: TradingBrain accepts setups based on false multi-timeframe confirmation.
findings.root_cause: Fallback lacks correct timestamped resampling or unavailable-state semantics.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed per missing timeframe or resample closed timestamped OHLC correctly.
findings.validation_test: Source outage fixtures must return UNKNOWN rather than a false aligned state.

findings.title: Snapshot freshness measures local collection time, not source data age or completeness
findings.observed_behavior: Any non-empty collected subset can receive a fresh local timestamp; source timestamps, BTC presence, gaps, and expected universe are not gated.
findings.failure_scenario: Partial or stale source data is wrapped in a fresh snapshot and scanned.
findings.impact: Signals may be generated from stale or incomplete markets.
findings.recommendation: Gate per-source timestamps, candle age/closure, universe completeness, gaps, and required BTC context.
findings.validation_test: Inject stale, partial, missing, duplicate, and out-of-order data.

findings.title: Outcome metrics are materially invalid and no backtest/OOS evidence exists
findings.observed_behavior: A periodically sampled point price decides outcomes; only setup exactly equal to SHORT uses short logic; no backtest engine exists.
findings.failure_scenario: PULLBACK SHORT follows long rules or both levels trade between polls with fabricated ordering.
findings.impact: Misleading win rate, PnL, confidence adjustment, and strategy claims.
findings.root_cause: Snapshot tracking substitutes for event-based backtesting.
findings.recommendation: Quarantine these metrics and implement a closed-OHLC next-bar cost-aware simulator with explicit direction.
findings.validation_test: Long/short, same-bar SL/TP, gaps, fees, funding, OOS and walk-forward tests.

findings.title: Risk controls are fragmented, incomplete, and partly fail-open
findings.observed_behavior: DB/history failures can become zero exposure or trading allowed; declared portfolio-risk constants are unused; manual entry uses a different gate.
findings.failure_scenario: A state failure or concurrent entries bypass aggregate exposure controls.
findings.impact: Incorrect exposure state and an unsafe base for future execution.
findings.root_cause: No authoritative fail-closed atomic risk service.
findings.recommendation: Create one final risk gate with atomic reservation, daily loss, drawdown, exposure and health checks.
findings.validation_test: DB failure, concurrent entry, daily-loss, drawdown, stale-balance and TOCTOU tests.

findings.title: OMS, exchange execution, reconciliation, and protective orders are absent
findings.observed_behavior: Private exchange code performs only account GET; entry and close mutate SQLite.
findings.failure_scenario: A future live call has no idempotency, fill state, timeout recovery, stop protection or restart reconciliation.
findings.impact: The system cannot safely control live capital.
findings.root_cause: A notification/paper tracker is not an execution architecture.
findings.recommendation: Keep live disabled and build an OMS, exchange-side protection, reconciliation and recovery before any executor.
findings.validation_test: Mock ACK-timeout, duplicate, partial-fill, cancel, restart, mismatch and reduce-only scenarios.

findings.title: Production credential, state, and log files are world-readable
findings.observed_behavior: The active service reads .env while local filesystem modes permit reads by other users.
findings.failure_scenario: A low-privilege local compromise copies bot/API/database credentials or state.
findings.impact: Bot takeover, confidentiality loss, and possible exchange impact depending on unverified key permissions.
findings.root_cause: Permissive file and directory ownership modes.
findings.recommendation: Apply owner-only permissions, dedicated service identity, rotate credentials, and verify no-withdrawal/IP whitelist.
findings.validation_test: Permission audit and rotation evidence without printing values.

findings.title: Internet-facing dashboard and admin routes lack authorization
findings.observed_behavior: The app listens on all interfaces; admin and chat routes have no auth dependency; direct SHA-256 and a literal JWT fallback are used.
findings.failure_scenario: A remote user enumerates accounts/usage or drives unauthorized LLM workload.
findings.impact: Confidentiality, cost, availability and account-integrity risk.
findings.root_cause: Token issuance is disconnected from route authorization.
findings.recommendation: Bind privately until JWT/RBAC, modern password hashing, mandatory secrets and rate limits are enforced.
findings.validation_test: Unauthenticated, role, brute-force and rate-limit tests.

findings.title: Telegram entry and close commands are not chat-authorized
findings.observed_behavior: Authorization is used for balance commands but not entry/close.
findings.failure_scenario: Any bot user creates or closes simulated positions.
findings.impact: Corrupt portfolio/risk state; critical if execution is ever attached.
findings.recommendation: Use global allowlist middleware and deny production startup without an allowlist.
findings.validation_test: Unauthorized-chat tests for every state-changing handler.

findings.title: Local trade and signal-dedup state are not atomic or idempotent
findings.observed_behavior: Relative DB path, no trade uniqueness/state-transition constraint, and unlocked non-atomic JSON overwrite.
findings.failure_scenario: Duplicate command/job or crash creates duplicate rows or corrupts dedup state.
findings.root_cause: No transactional idempotency key or durable state machine.
findings.recommendation: Use absolute configured storage, transactions, unique keys and atomic durable state.

findings.title: Signals are recorded before risk, dedup, and dispatch succeed
findings.observed_behavior: record_signal runs before process_signal can reject or fail.
findings.failure_scenario: A risk-rejected, duplicate, or unsent signal enters performance history.
findings.recommendation: Persist generated/validated/sent/rejected states and start outcome tracking only after send acknowledgement.
findings.validation_test: Risk reject, duplicate, Telegram timeout and restart tests.

findings.title: Position sizing is advisory and not exchange-precision safe
findings.observed_behavior: Float linear-unit math omits finite/config bounds, instrument metadata, fees, slippage, leverage, tick/step and min notional.
findings.failure_scenario: Displayed quantity is invalid or understates risk.
findings.impact: Unsafe manual sizing and unusable live order quantity.
findings.root_cause: Generic calculator is not instrument-aware execution sizing.
findings.recommendation: Use Decimal, instrument metadata, conservative rounding and strict finite/bounds checks.
findings.validation_test: Property tests across spot/perpetual instruments and pathological inputs.

findings.title: Confidence and probability labels are uncalibrated heuristic scores
findings.observed_behavior: Rule points are presented as confidence/probability without empirical calibration.
findings.root_cause: No labels, OOS dataset, calibration or drift monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Rename to heuristic score until validated and calibrated leakage-free.
findings.validation_test: Reliability curve, Brier/log loss and regime stability tests.

findings.title: Auto-alert score threshold is unreachable
findings.observed_behavior: The alert requires 160 while upstream score is clamped to 100.
findings.failure_scenario: The intended auto-alert path never emits.
findings.impact: Missed notifications and false operational confidence.
findings.recommendation: Define one score range and compatible threshold.
findings.validation_test: A maximum-quality opportunity must trigger at the configured boundary.

findings.title: API import mutates the database and health is not readiness
findings.observed_behavior: A global PostgreSQL connection executes CREATE/commit during import; health always returns ok.
findings.failure_scenario: Import/test changes production schema or stale DB connection breaks traffic while health stays green.
findings.root_cause: Migration, connection lifecycle, and readiness are conflated with module import.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit migrations, pooled request-scoped connections and dependency-aware readiness.
findings.validation_test: Import-no-write, DB outage, stale-connection and readiness tests.

findings.title: No automated tests and broad exception handling hide failures
findings.observed_behavior: No test files exist; static scan counted 297 broad exception handlers and about 80 exception-pass patterns; seven local import targets are absent.
findings.failure_scenario: A risk/data dependency silently disables after a change.
findings.impact: Critical regressions can reach the active signal service undetected.
findings.root_cause: No CI test safety net and degraded-mode behavior is not explicit.
findings.recommendation: Add risk-first unit/integration tests, typed contracts, narrow exceptions and fallback metrics.
findings.validation_test: CI must fail on critical contract and fallback regressions.

findings.title: Deployment paths, process ownership, and worktree state are inconsistent
findings.observed_behavior: Deploy script targets /home/ubuntu while audited repo is /opt; dashboard runs although discovered API service is inactive and points elsewhere.
findings.failure_scenario: Deployment updates a different tree or an unmanaged process keeps old code.
findings.root_cause: No canonical immutable release path/process manifest.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate paths and units, expose active commit, and enforce clean-release checks.
findings.validation_test: After deployment, process CWD and reported commit must equal the release manifest.

unknowns: Actual exchange API permissions, withdrawal disablement, and IP whitelist were not inspected.

PostgreSQL runtime state, backup contents, restore drills, and retention were not inspected.

Runtime logs, databases, current positions, and historical performance were not read.
Webhook service authentication outside the repository is unknown.
The active dashboard process commit and process supervisor are unknown.
